features.name: Chronal Shift
features.short: Reaction: force a reroll on any roll you see.
features.summary: When you or a creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, you can use your reaction to force a reroll after seeing the result. Two uses per long rest.

features.name: Temporal Awareness
features.summary: You can add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.

features.name: Momentary Stasis
features.short: Action: freeze a Large or smaller creature in time.
features.summary: As an action, a Large or smaller creature within 60 ft. makes a CON save or is incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage. Uses: INT modifier per long rest.

features.name: Arcane Abeyance
features.short: Store a 4th-level-or-lower spell in a bead for later.
features.summary: When you cast a spell of 4th level or lower, you can condense it into a bead for 1 hour; a creature holding it can release the spell as an action using your spell DC and attack. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Convergent Future
features.short: Reaction: decide whether a roll succeeds or fails, at a cost.
features.summary: When you or a creature you can see makes a roll, you can use your reaction to decide it succeeds or fails instead. Each use gives you a level of exhaustion that only a long rest removes.
